title: Home Mortgage Loans: late charge grace period, state percentages and courtesy waivers
content:
# Home Mortgage Loans: late charge grace period, state percentages and courtesy waivers

This document sets out, for every Home Mortgage Loans program, the late charge grace period, the late charge percentage for each state of residence, and the number of courtesy late charge waivers a customer may receive in a rolling 365 days.

## Schedule by program

| Program | Grace period (calendar days after the due date) | Late charge, North Carolina (NC) (%) | Late charge, South Carolina (SC) (%) | Late charge, Virginia (VA) (%) | Courtesy waivers per customer in a rolling 365 days |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 15 | 4.00 | 4.00 | 4.00 | 1 |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 15 | 4.00 | 4.00 | 4.00 | 1 |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 15 | 4.00 | 5.00 | 5.00 | 1 |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 15 | 4.00 | 5.00 | 5.00 | 1 |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 15 | 4.00 | 5.00 | 5.00 | 1 |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 15 | 4.00 | 5.00 | 5.00 | 2 |

## Meaning of each column

- **Grace period** is the number of calendar days after an installment's due date before a late charge applies.
- **Late charge percentage** is stated as a percent of the principal and interest part of the installment, and is selected by the borrower's state of residence.
- **Courtesy waivers** is the number of courtesy late charge waivers per customer in a rolling 365 days.

## Reading the state columns (hypothetical borrowers)

| Hypothetical borrower | Program | State of residence | Percentage from the table |
|---|---|---|---|
| Borrower A | Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | South Carolina | 5.00 |
| Borrower B | Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | North Carolina | 4.00 |
| Borrower C | FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | Virginia | 4.00 |
| Borrower D | Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | Virginia | 5.00 |

The percentage follows the borrower's state of residence, not the program name: the "VA" column is the state of Virginia, and the VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage program has its own row.

## Basis Q&A

- **Does any program have a different grace period?** No; every program allows 15 calendar days.
- **Which program allows more than one courtesy waiver in a rolling 365 days?** Only the Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage, which allows 2.
